description: From the water's edge, the lagoon stretches out still and dark, its surface mirroring the night sky with a broken trail of moonlight down the center. The wooden jetty reaches out into the frame from the foreground, posts and planks picked out by soft light. Under a partly cloudy sky, reed beds fade into darkness along the shore, and the whole scene holds the hush of the Albufera after the day's boats have gone.
